decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ update removes Big Block references and records the new primary-mint split, but it omits the retained $4 founder allocation from secondary royalties and their remaining Small Block funding use.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.buyer_earnings: Explain the instant $5 commission and Small Block prize tickets, while stating that any future governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_operation: Explain that each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code, successful referred mints award $5 plus Small Block tickets, and no-referral mints allocate the commission and Small Block tickets to a random existing NFT holder.

block_prizes.pool_funding: Every sale continues funding the Small Block prize pool.

value_updates.prize_tickets: Explain that each successful referral awards one Small Block ticket, more tickets produce more chances to win, tickets expire after the applicable draw, and later referrals apply to subsequent Small Blocks.

fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.purpose: Add a dedicated FAQ explaining how non-crypto fiat buyers receive and access commissions and Small Block prizes.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.wallet_provisioning: Explain that a seedless non-custodial wallet is created in the background and stores the buyer's NFT and rewards.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.purchase_flow: Explain that Transak converts fiat to crypto and mints to the newly created wallet without manual wallet configuration.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.access_information: Explain that the confirmation email supplies the mint number, NFT details, and dashboard link.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.commission_access: Explain that $5 referral commissions arrive automatically and can be monitored through the dashboard using an email link or SIWE.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.prize_access: Explain that referrals award tickets for the recurring $500 Small Block draw, winners are announced and emailed, and prize funds are sent directly to the winner's wallet.

value_updates.single_level_and_founder_share: Explain that referrals are single-level, source is verified on Basescan, each $15 primary mint is split $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool, while $4 from each secondary sale goes to the founder and the remaining royalty proceeds fund the Small Block prize pool.

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-195 MODIFY recording the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block allocation for primary mints.
Removing Big Blocks and changing proceeds allocation does not alter transfer of the book, referral code, badges, or remaining active and expired Small Block tickets.
The prize and proceeds decision does not change deployment on Base or the Ethereum L2 classification.
The NFT ebook, unlimited-mint model, $15 mint price, and mint-number identifier remain unchanged.
The Small Block remains a recurring $500 draw after 100 qualifying sales, and its state already records ongoing funding from secondary-sale royalties.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block counter-independence attribute; all remaining Small Block ticket rules remain valid.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block tickets and draws from the About-page process copy while retaining the valid Small Block content.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key.
The candidate still defines a Small-or-Big-Block eligible population and a Big Block ticket cohort, both of which become stale when Big Blocks are removed.
